questions.q: Lightning can strike the same place twice.
questions.note: Tall objects get struck again and again.
They happen together, but light travels faster.

questions.q: Clouds are made of tiny water droplets.
questions.note: Or tiny ice crystals, high up.

questions.q: A rainbow is really a full circle.
questions.note: From a plane you can see the whole circle.
Small drops are round, big ones look like buns.
